ICS 13.040.20CHD 35New Standard from Last Update.NATIONAL FOREWORDThis Indian Standard, which is identical with ISO 16000-2 : 2004 ‘Indoor air - Part 2: Sampling strategy for formaldehyde’ issued by the International Organization for Standardization (ISO), was adopted by the Bureau of Indian Standards on recommendation of the Air Quality Sectional Committee and approval of the Chemical Division Council.This Indian Standard is published in several parts. The other parts in this series are:Part 1 General aspects of sampling strategyPart 3 Determination of formaldehyde and other carbonyl compounds in indoor air and test chamber air - Active sampling methodPart 4 Determination of formaldehyde - Diffusive sampling methodPart 37 Measurement of PM 2.5 mass concentrationPart 40 Indoor air quality management system
